m66893 9112 DIAGNOSED AND FIXED, both halves, deployed (mastra e0ab113b… wait — mastra 53a53c30, dispatcher e0ab113b, writer cb797771, bbtracker 691f037f; commits 0514332d, 5510da21, 9dcce0f). THE TOOL HALF: attempts parsed red signatures as code:subject:stage, so UNHEALABLE:<repo>:split (two parts after the strip) read the STAGE as the subject and returned zero rows — fixed; the same call now returns the split rows and their story. THE BURN ITSELF, read from those rows: the auto-split SUCCEEDS, then reports itself via /dispatch/blocked, the reason contains "codegen size-wall" so retryBlocked classified it TRANSIENT and requeued the parent, which size-walled and split again — 598 laps/24h; and when a section title carried punctuation the exact-title dedup missed and it filed a FRESH CHILD SET each lap (BEB-3582: 40+ duplicate children, all but one now cancelled by the hygiene sweep). THE FIX, three cuts: the parent's own AUTO-SPLIT comment is the durable split-once record — children reused, never re-filed; auto-split reasons classify HARD so the parent parks as the epic (the terminal state it always wanted); and mastra's apparatus list gains the sections the dispatcher's already had (Creds required, Interface, …) — 8733's split-on-apparatus class ends. Watch the split count on the next red sweep: 598/24h should fall to ~0. ALSO DEPLOYED: contract route-pinning — overnight the 8734 remint followed the drifted artefact's routes (POST /nodes), which would have verified the drift; an api contract now keeps its prior route set until the TICKET changes, live listing seeds only the first mint. 9113 (refine branch-head race + the 1101-page-parsed-as-JSON) is next on my daily set after this morning's sequence. Attempts-cap question you asked (why 598 never tripped): these laps each looked like lap 1 — blocked→requeued resets the visible streak; the epic-park removes the lap entirely.

m66880 GRIDPANE + VULTR, checked DIRECTLY (not through the dead-door assumption), finding graphed gridpane-alive-vultr-key-ip-locked. GRIDPANE IS NOT DEAD — the 08-30 "1042 on every route" is stale. gp_health: state connected, API reachable, token present + VALID. tools/list and bebond_list_servers answer with a real abilifi session: 5 servers, 4 Active (45.32.238.56, 173.199.119.38 = abilifi-1, 45.76.28.59, 155.138.223.251) + 1 FAILED (id 33526 = 144.202.22.195), all Vultr IPs. The ONLY real door bug and I fixed it (mcp-gp ea9f30a2, commit f3f4620): bare POST /gp never matched the route pattern /gp/* and fell to the zone catch-all worker whose "Not found. Use /mcp" 404 is exactly what read as dead — added route mcp.bebond.net/gp; /gp/ always worked. VULTR BILLING — cannot answer from the CC box: vultr:api (in the vault, len 36) is IP-ALLOWLISTED at Vultr, GET /v2/account returns verbatim 401 "Unauthorized IP address: 188.89.107.36". So the number is unreadable here by design, not missing. Two-credential split confirmed (BEB-6010): GridPane holds its OWN Vultr provider credential for the rental it manages; vultr:api is a separate CC key. If rental+billing runs through GridPane's internal cred, our key never sees those charges. WHERE BILLING STOPPED: not at our door (up) and not answerable at our key (IP-blocked) — the one real next step is a Vultr /v2/account + /v2/billing call from an ALLOWLISTED origin (a worker on the CF egress, or abilifi-1), which the loop can do and CC from here cannot. No evidence of a GridPane outage anywhere.
